references.text: Prohibits sexual relations with a father's wife, which parallels the prohibition against taking one's father's wife and uncovering his nakedness
Prescribes the death penalty for anyone who lies with his father's wife, because he has uncovered his father's nakedness
Declares a curse upon anyone who lies with his father's wife, because he uncovers his father's garment
The prophet Ezekiel condemns those in Jerusalem who dishonor their father's wife by uncovering her nakedness
Paul refers to a case of sexual immorality in Corinth where a man is living with his father's wife, which is a violation of this command
